Specification: This specification models a single-variable system with one state variable b. The initial condition requires b to be an element of BOOLEAN, and the temporal specification requires every step to satisfy the boxed subscripted action [][b' \in BOOLEAN]_b, meaning that b always remains a Boolean value and stuttering is allowed. The file is extremely small, has no explicit fault model, no helper operators beyond Spec, and asserts a simple temporal type-correctness property over the variable.
